rules.name: BR-LIB.UC01-001 - Renewal window
rules.rule_summary: Renew is enabled from 30 days before expiry until 90 days after it.

rules.name: BR-LIB.UC01-002 - Window messages
rules.rule_summary: Outside the window the page shows the not-yet or lapsed message.

rules.name: BR-LIB.UC01-003 - Fines block
rules.rule_summary: A balance of 25.00 or more blocks renewal with a pay-fines message.

rules.name: BR-LIB.UC01-004 - New expiry date
rules.rule_summary: The new expiry is three years after the old expiry date.

rules.name: BR-LIB.UC01-005 - Renewal history
rules.rule_summary: Each renewal writes a history row with both dates and the staff ID or ONLINE.

rules.name: BR-LIB.UC02-001 - Daily accrual
rules.rule_summary: A late loan accrues 0.25 a day, closed days excluded.

rules.name: BR-LIB.UC02-002 - Fine cap
rules.rule_summary: One loan's fine stops at 10.00; a lost item is charged its replacement cost instead.

rules.name: BR-LIB.UC02-003 - Supervisor waiver
rules.rule_summary: Only a supervisor can waive, with a reason code, and each waiver is audited.
